events.line: Ilir, you absolute coward—benched Jalen Coker while he put up 29.8 points on your bench like some kind of fantasy lottery ticket you threw away at the gas station.
Veton, you absolute fucking coward—Brock Purdy sitting on your bench just dropped 21 points and you couldn't even work up the balls to start your own quarterback, what the hell is wrong with you?

Caleb went absolutely nuclear with 37.3 points and you still started him like a goddamn genius instead of some panic-stricken dipshit—guess even a broken clock is right twice a day when your QB1 decides to have the game of his fucking life.

Faton actually fucking nailed it for once—Swift went absolutely nuclear and made that 11.4 projection look like a joke, but let's be honest, you started him despite everyone writing him off this week anyway so you can't take full credit for this one.

Nori, I don't know if you accidentally stumbled into genius or if Watson fell out of the sky, but holy shit—29.7 points when you were bracing for 9? Your dumbass accidentally played 4D chess this week, and honestly, that's the scariest part.

Rob, you absolute coward—you benched Monangai and he just put up nearly 20 points on your bench like he was auditioning for your lineup next week. That's what happens when you panic and get cute instead of just riding your guy.
Rinor actually had the balls to start Henry and he went absolutely nuclear—maybe next time trust your own roster instead of panic-checking rankings at 11:59 PM like a psychopath.

Rinor, you absolute dipshit—Vele went off for 16 points on your bench while you probably started some washed-up vet who caught 2 balls for 8 yards, and now you're gonna lose by exactly that margin, aren't you?
Josh Allen just shit the bed... in the best way possible and you still almost benched him, Ilir—dude put up 35.7 on a 19.3 projection and you were probably sweating bullets about it.
Isaiah Likely just threw up a fucking 23.8 on your ass and you started him anyway—congrats on the accidental genius move, Flamur, but let's be real, you had no idea this was coming.
